public enum ServerHttpObservationDocumentation extends Enum<ServerHttpObservationDocumentation> implements io.micrometer.observation.docs.ObservationDocumentation
Documented KeyValues for the HTTP server observations for reactive web applications.

该类由自动化工具用于记录附加到 HTTP 服务器观察结果的 KeyValues。
